column1: # TRIAGE for the derived checked set (issue 114 part 2).
# Every (collection, filter) the code can emit must appear here with a disposition.
# A key present in checked-set.tsv and absent here is a LOUD FAILURE, not a silent
# omission — that is the whole point. The gate's old coverage was a hand-written list
# of rows, which is why it carried a check for a read issue 19 had deleted (B5) while
# nothing checked read::organizations, walking 25.3M rows on a public endpoint.
#   asserted        a B-row in hot_read_plans.sh plans this read
#   unfiltered-page correct by design: no filter, so driving the table in primary-key
#                   order IS the page order. Nothing to assert.
#   ignored-filter  the builder drops this parameter and emits the unfiltered statement
#                   byte-for-byte (issue 118). Not a distinct read; the DEFECT is that
#                   the client is not told. Tracked there, not assertable here.
#   candidate       a filter-specific read with no check yet. NOT a defect claim — a
#                   rowid access is printed both for a one-row lookup and a full walk,
#                   so each needs reading before it is asserted or dismissed.
#   unservable      no index can serve it; needs a schema answer before a check can
#                   have an achievable pass state (rule 4). Reason required.
